## Notes for the expert
- harness: `git checkout config/ghidra/comments.tsv` with core.autocrlf=true wrote CRLF; db.py then refused (`CR in file`). Restored the LF copy (byte-identical to HEAD by cmp). Reverts of LF-strict tsv: copy back a backup, not git checkout. generalizable:
- Brief said revert planted db.py with git checkout; db.py was uncommitted work, so the plant was reverted from a backup copy instead.
- `kind=code status=verified` includes 23 `data_*` ids (same set pairs.verified_code_ids used before); count 246.
- The split recipe prints a long `split: src 246 regions <ids>` line on every re-split (pre-existing).
